summary.text: Phil Gray is the Libertarian Party nominee for Texas's 26th District, a repeat candidate who has appeared on Texas congressional ballots in several districts since 2016. Ballotpedia lists his career experience as business owner and property manager. His campaign materials emphasize reducing the national debt, immigration reform, drug decriminalization and healthcare price transparency.

paragraphs.text: Career experience includes owning a business and working as a property manager; has been affiliated with AARP, LULAC and the Urban League, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists earlier Libertarian candidacies for Texas's 1st District (2016), 27th District (2020), 30th District (2022) and 26th District (2024).
In 2024 he received 2.3% (8,773 votes) in the general election for this seat, won by Brandon Gill. Advanced from the Libertarian convention on March 21, 2026, for this year's race.

His 2024 campaign website, as reproduced by Ballotpedia, stated a goal of national debt reduction, immigration reform that lets undocumented immigrants voluntarily pay toward the national debt, decriminalizing drug use, and healthcare price transparency.
